raw_ocr_text:
ALL that certain lot, parcel or tract of land, situate and lying in the Borough of Haddonfield, County of Camden and State of New Jersey being more particularly described as follows:

Beginning at a point in the Southwesterly right of way line of Washington avenue (40 feet wide) where intersected by Northerly line of Lot 12.02, said point being South 25 degrees 06 minutes 00 seconds East, 72.02 feet from the intersection of said right of way line of Washington Avenue with the Southeasterly line of Lot 12, Block 76 and running; thence

(1) Along said Southwesterly right of way line of Washington Avenue, South 25 degrees 06 minutes 00 seconds East, 24.40 feet to a point in same, thence
(2) Along the common line of Lots 12.02 and 12.03, Block 76, South 61 degrees 23 minutes 09 seconds West, 74.80 feet to a point in the Northeasterly line of Lot 12.08 Block 76; thence
(3) Along said Northeasterly line of Lot 12.08, North 28 degrees 36 minutes 51 seconds West, 24.18 feet to a point in the Southerly line of Lot 11.01, Block 76; thence
(4) Along said Southerly line of Lot 11.01, North 61 degrees 15 minutes 26 seconds East, 76.30 feet to the point and place of beginning.
expected_legal_description: Beginning at a point in the Southwesterly right of way line of Washington avenue (40 feet wide) where intersected by Northerly line of Lot 12.02; thence (1) through (4) to the point and place of beginning.
expected_normalized_text: Beginning at a point in the Southwesterly right of way line of Washington avenue (40 feet wide) where intersected by Northerly line of Lot 12.02, said point being South 25 degrees 06 minutes 00 seconds East, 72.02 feet from the intersection of said right of way line of Washington Avenue with the Southeasterly line of Lot 12, Block 76
expected_pob: a point in the Southwesterly right of way line of Washington Avenue (40 feet wide) where intersected by Northerly line of Lot 12.02

expected_calls.along: Southwesterly right of way line of Washington Avenue
common line of Lots 12.02 and 12.03, Block 76
expected_calls.to: a point in the Northeasterly line of Lot 12.08 Block 76
a point in the Southerly line of Lot 11.01, Block 76
the point and place of beginning

critical_assertions.note: First lot from Washington Avenue end. NE/SW bearings differ slightly between calls 2 (S 61d23'09" W) and 4 (N 61d15'26" E) because they follow different lot lines.

common_failure_modes: Calls 2 and 4 have different bearings (61d23'09" vs 61d15'26") - these are NOT parallel lot lines
notes: Lot 12.02 fronts on Washington Avenue (24.40 ft) and extends ~75 ft back to the Lot 12.08 boundary. It borders Lot 11.01 to the NW and Lot 12.03 to the SE.
